hook: She stole a jet in GTA 6 with her brain.
hookText: Stealing a jet with her brain

beats.say: Streamer Perrikaryal flew off with a jet in GTA 6 using EEG commands and eye tracking, after ages of practice. The clip looks like mind reading.
The real story is quieter. The headset does not read thoughts; it reads brain signals and eye movements, and the clip does not show the practice behind it.
The article asks why this matters beyond one streamer, and what the clip leaves out about how the headset really works.
